source.accepted_proposal: MP008 is conditional on project-considered in vitro clearance translation. Check system/result type, normalization, relevant assay conditions, method-dependent supporting inputs and elimination-component coverage. Leave equations, defaults and prediction evaluation downstream; do not require PBPK or block independent animal work.

profile.name: Data requirements for in vitro clearance translation
target_endpoints: Project-requested clearance predictions supported by in vitro hepatic metabolism evidence
outputs: Method-dependent additional inputs and evidence scope
profile.applies_when: Enable only when the project considers and permits in vitro metabolism evidence for clearance prediction. Reuse the existing biological-context, provenance and access metadata. This profile checks inputs for the hepatic IVIVE branch; it does not predict clearance.
required_inputs: The experimental system, such as microsomes or hepatocytes, and the reported result type: original time-series observations, metabolic stability, half-life or reported intrinsic clearance (CLint).
The reported units and normalization basis, including protein amount or cell count where applicable, linked to the result definition.
Recorded concentration range, incubation timing and experimental conditions relevant to the intended use, with unspecified information retained as a gap.
conditional_inputs: Scaling factors or physiological inputs only when required by an approach explicitly considered in the project; retain their source and unresolved applicability without selecting an equation or inserting defaults.
Incubation or plasma/blood binding inputs only when required by that approach. Reference MP007 for binding-specific checks rather than repeating them.
acceptable_alternatives: Original observations and reported in vitro estimates may be registered at their actual evidence level; neither is automatically an accepted clearance-prediction input.
An independently supported animal-based branch may continue when the optional hepatic-IVIVE inputs are unavailable.
data_checks: Identify what was measured or reported and in which experimental system. Do not interchange stability, half-life and intrinsic-clearance results without preserving their definitions.
Check that the result units and protein/cell normalization basis are explicit. Flag incompatible or unspecified bases rather than directly combining or converting them here.
Record available assay conditions and their relevance to the proposed use; list missing conditions or uncertainty about applicability.
Check only the additional inputs required by the project-considered approach. Do not choose an extrapolation equation, fill physiological constants or test prediction accuracy in this stage.
Label the elimination component represented by the evidence. Evidence limited to hepatic metabolism does not by itself establish complete input coverage for total systemic clearance.
profile.missing_effect: Report the affected IVIVE candidate and its missing material through the general data-gap policy. Missing optional in vitro inputs do not block independent animal PK analysis.
not_established: A calculated or validated clearance prediction, complete total-clearance evidence from a hepatic component alone, or a requirement to build PBPK.
